title.narrative: GCCA+ Building Local Climate Resilience in Mozambique

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to support the Government´s efforts to reduce climate vulnerability through improving delivery of climate resilient basic services to the rural communities and enhancing the knowledge-based decision making in the selected Provinces.
